aesthetic: antique parchment background with subtle grain
clean TCG UI language with a compact art window
print-ready color grading, restrained contrast, no neon saturation
negative: no text outside the card border

WORD_CARD.header: Top-left: the collector number as # followed by the exact supplied digits in their exact order (render the NUMBER value verbatim, never reordered or repadded), then the navy type pill; top-right: the rarity text and diamond.
WORD_CARD.placeholders: The reference template is a blank form: every bracketed string ([ABILITY DESCRIPTION HERE], [OT VERSE CITATION AND TEXT HERE], [NT VERSE CITATION AND TEXT HERE], [HEBREW WORD], [GREEK WORD], [TRANSLIT], [OT CITATIONS], [TRIVIA POINT 1/2/3]) and every placeholder label (CARD TITLE, DEFINITION TEXT, #XXX, SERIES: 20XX QX - Set) marks a slot to be REPLACED entirely by the corresponding supplied content value. Never print any placeholder string, the word TITLE after the card word, or square brackets anywhere on the finished card. The footer bar prints SERIES: followed by the exact supplied SERIES value and nothing more - the template's '- Set' suffix and the DEFINITION TEXT label are placeholder text that must never appear; the gloss line replaces DEFINITION TEXT entirely. The HEBREW/ARAMAIC and GREEK panels sit directly beneath the NT VERSE panel with only their own two headers; never add an ORIGINAL LANGUAGES heading or any other heading the template does not print.

geometry.frame: identical across all type and rarity combinations

WORD_CARD.stat_pips: Fifteen stat circles in three labeled groups of five, copied from the template's pip row exactly and ALL LEFT EMPTY: every pip is a thin navy outline with a plain parchment interior at the template's exact positions and sizes; never fill a pip. The stat values are applied after rendering by the deterministic fixed-elements stamp.

art_direction.subject_rule: Represent people through what they are known for: defining work, objects, attire, gestures, environments, symbols, or achievements.
art_direction.figure_rule: If a human figure is necessary, keep the figure secondary and show it from behind, in silhouette, at a distance, with the face obscured, or cropped so no recognizable face appears. Never a crowd, gathering, or group of people; prefer no people at all, or exactly one figure seen from behind, in silhouette, or at a distance.
art_direction.style_rule: The illustration panel is a luminous, vibrant, full-color cinematic oil painting with impressionistic brushwork - deep shadowed backgrounds lit by one radiant golden light source, rich saturated blues and golds, ethereal atmosphere, a strong symbolic subject - in the manner of the printed Hypertext set (example cards 001-020); never sepia, monochrome, engraving, etching, woodcut, or line art. The frame and panels stay antique parchment and navy; only the artwork inside the art window carries this vivid painterly style. This standard style is the default for every card in a base set; an alternate palette or register (for example a cool underwater or nocturne treatment) is an expansion-level decision, never a per-card one, so that all faces in a set match.

original_language_layout.native_script: large centered native script with every supplied diacritic preserved
original_language_layout.transliteration: bare italic transliteration directly below the native script; no TRANSLIT label, no parentheses, and no added English gloss
original_language_layout.left_refs: OT Refs: followed by the exact supplied OT_REFS string; the literal label 'OT Refs:' is mandatory and must be printed at the start of the line
original_language_layout.right_refs: NT Refs: followed by the exact supplied NT_REFS string; the literal label 'NT Refs:' is mandatory and must be printed at the start of the line
original_language_layout.density: match the compact height, spacing, and hierarchy of the printed SEE reference

LOT.spec_boundary: The received Lot Reward section ended after 'trim'. Only the declared reward field and frame geometry are represented; no omitted reward content or geometry is inferred.

NOUN.prompt: TYPE is exactly NOUN; the white header icon is a closed book.

VERB.prompt: TYPE is exactly VERB; the white header icon is a pencil.

ADJECTIVE.prompt: TYPE is exactly ADJECTIVE; the white header icon is a sparkle pencil.

NAME.prompt: TYPE is exactly NAME; the white header icon is a feather quill.

TITLE.prompt: TYPE label is exactly TITLE; icon concept is an ornate empty rectangular frame; style is a simple white silhouette.

COMMON.prompt: RARITY is exactly COMMON, printed in title case as 'Common' exactly like the template (never all capitals), followed by one white diamond; no activation cost.

UNCOMMON.prompt: RARITY is exactly UNCOMMON, printed in title case as 'Uncommon' exactly like the template (never all capitals), followed by one green diamond; no activation cost.

RARE.prompt: RARITY is exactly RARE, printed in title case as 'Rare' exactly like the template (never all capitals), followed by one gold diamond; below it show the activation cost as a plus sign followed by ONE plain card back copied from the template - a solid uniformly dark navy rounded rectangle with a thin outline and a completely blank face; never draw a cross, symbol, letter, or any marking on the card back.

GLORIOUS.prompt: RARITY is exactly GLORIOUS, printed in title case as 'Glorious' exactly like the template (never all capitals), followed by one orange diamond; below it show the activation cost as TWO plain card backs with a plus sign between them, copied from the template - each a solid uniformly dark navy rounded rectangle with a thin outline and a completely blank face; never draw a cross, symbol, letter, or any marking on the card backs.
